Evaluation Protocol & Split Integrity

• Strict 1-to-1 Matching: Greedy bipartite IoU matching with mutual category alias reconciliation.

• Split Isolation: 12 train/dev pairs and 6 held-out final test pairs maintain zero transcript overlap to prevent data contamination.

• Reproducibility: Verification suite runs via ./run_tests.sh with 79 passing tests.
